threats.label: Deepfakes (audio/video)
threats.desc: AI-generated images, audio, or video of candidates saying or doing things they never did.

threats.label: Text disinformation
threats.desc: Mass-produced fake news stories, comments, and posts authored by language models.

threats.label: Micro-targeting
threats.desc: AI-personalized ads and messages tailored to individual voters' psychological vulnerabilities.

threats.label: Voter suppression via false info
threats.desc: False information about voting locations, hours, eligibility, or ID requirements.

threats.label: Infrastructure attacks
threats.desc: AI-enhanced attacks on voter rolls, election websites, or vote-tabulation systems.

deepfake|social.example: 2024: AI-generated voice clips circulated on TikTok/X within hours of original posts; many viral before fact-check.

deepfake|email.example: Targeted spear-phishing with deepfake audio of a campaign manager authorizing actions.

deepfake|broadcast.example: 2024 NH primary: AI-cloned voice of President Biden urged voters not to vote in primary (robocall).
deepfake|broadcast.counter: FCC ban on AI voice in robocalls (Feb 2024); broadcast-network verification.

deepfake|inperson.example: AI-generated robocalls in rural areas where independent fact-checking is sparse.
deepfake|inperson.counter: State-level criminal penalties for election deception.

textdis|social.example: LLM-generated comment armies make fringe positions appear mainstream.
textdis|social.counter: Bot detection; provenance signals (C2PA); platform moderation.

textdis|email.example: AI-tailored phishing emails impersonate poll workers or candidates.

textdis|broadcast.example: Fake "news" sites use LLMs to produce thousands of articles cited on social media.

textdis|inperson.example: AI-generated flyers and door-hangers that mimic official election materials.

micro|social.example: AI tailors ad copy to each voter's emotional triggers, A/B-tested in real time.
micro|social.counter: Ad-transparency laws; ban on issue ads close to election.

micro|email.example: Personalized fundraising emails using AI-inferred psychological profiles.

micro|broadcast.example: Geo-targeted streaming ads use AI to serve different versions to different demographics.
micro|broadcast.counter: Ad-archive disclosure rules; FCC oversight of streaming.

micro|inperson.example: AI-driven canvassing apps prioritize visits based on predicted persuadability.

suppress|social.example: False posts claiming polls closed early or voter ID is required when it isn't.
suppress|social.counter: Platform priority labeling for election-day misinformation.

suppress|email.example: AI-generated emails to voters in targeted precincts with wrong polling place addresses.

suppress|broadcast.example: AI-altered video of officials announcing fake voting changes.

suppress|inperson.example: 2020-style robocalls falsely warning of arrests at polling places (now AI-enhanced).
suppress|inperson.counter: Federal & state election-deception statutes; rapid law enforcement.

infra|social.example: AI-coordinated DDoS or doxxing campaigns against election workers.

infra|email.example: AI-crafted phishing of election officials' credentials to access voter rolls or pollbooks.

infra|broadcast.example: AI-generated fake "results" feeds spliced into news broadcasts.
infra|broadcast.counter: Multi-source verification; AP & state EOS protocols.

infra|inperson.example: AI-coordinated harassment of poll workers tied to false fraud claims.
infra|inperson.counter: Federal protections (DOJ Election Threats Task Force).

whatWorks: Provenance/watermarking standards (C2PA) being adopted by major platforms and AI vendors.
Faster human + automated fact-check pipelines coupled with platform priority labeling.
Media-literacy curricula starting in middle school.
Targeted legal penalties for election-deception (state laws + federal robocall ban).
CISA and DOJ Election Threats Task Force coordination on infrastructure security.
